question: We would like to get a new detaljplan for about 12 homes on Gotland. How does Region Gotland handle such requests, and how quickly would our plan be worked on?
key_points: A project that needs a new detaljplan starts with a planbesked application, which tells whether the project is suitable given the översiktsplan and public interests
Region Gotland has a plan queue and a prioritisation model (adopted 2022, revised December 2025) that decides the order in which plans are worked on
Plans enabling at least 10 homes in areas with a high share of permanent residents get priority 1; fewer than 10 homes there get priority 2
Projects in areas with a low share of permanent residents get priority 3 and may be proposed for refusal, as may requests contrary to the översiktsplan
The kommun must give its planbesked within four months (PBL 5 kap. 4 §), but the plan work itself starts only when the case reaches the front of the queue

question: We have an idea for a regenerative eco-village near Kårsta in Vallentuna: about 20 tiny houses, a shared greenhouse and a composting toilet system, on a few hectares of farmland we could buy. The land is outside any detaljplan. What are we missing, and how could we make this work?
key_points: Obstacle: a group of 20 houses is new sammanhållen bebyggelse and needs a detaljplan (PBL 4 kap. 2 §); single bygglov or förhandsbesked cannot be used for it
Obstacle: building on productive farmland (brukningsvärd jordbruksmark) is only allowed for essential public interests when no other land is suitable (MB 3 kap. 4 §)
Lever: start with a planbesked request; the ÖP wants Kårsta to grow as a small station village next to existing buildings near the station, which supports a well-placed site
Lever: organise shared facilities (sewage, roads, greenhouse) as a gemensamhetsanläggning under the anläggningslag; a sewage system needs a permit or notification to the kommun (FMH 13 §)
Ask: where exactly the plot is relative to the station and existing buildings, whether the land is actively farmed, and how water supply would be solved

question: We run a small farm on Gotland outside any village and want to add six guest cabins for farm stays, with a shared well and one shared wastewater system. Can you help us think this through: what would block it and what options do we have?
key_points: Obstacle: Gotland's groundwater is scarce and vulnerable (thin soils, fissured limestone, relict salt water), so the water supply and wastewater solution decide the case; wells must not be drilled too deep
Lever: Region Gotland prefers, after the public network, shared water and sewage solutions run by a samfällighetsförening under a gemensamhetsanläggning, before individual ones

Obstacle: a wastewater system with WC needs a permit from the miljö- och byggnämnd (FMH 13 §), which should be applied for after the bygglov; Gotland's guidelines set treatment requirements that vary by area
Lever: cabins for an existing farm business are assessed by bygglov / förhandsbesked outside a detaljplan; a förhandsbesked can settle the location first
Ask: where the farm is (coast, protection level for wastewater), how many people at most, and whether the cabins are part of the farm business

question: I farm land in the countryside of Uppsala kommun and would like to build three or four houses for farm workers and family members, and maybe sell a couple of plots later. What do I need to think about, and what is the best way to go about it?
key_points: Lever: Uppsala's ÖP allows new homes in the countryside as a complement to a rural business (landsbygdsnäring) when needed to run or develop it
Obstacle: otherwise new homes are mostly limited to small additions to existing clusters; eight or more plots together form sammanhållen bebyggelse, and a new group would need a detaljplan

Obstacle: building on productive farmland is restricted (MB 3 kap. 4 §); the location is assessed against water, sewage, traffic and landscape

key_points: No bygglov is needed for a komplementbostadshus of at most 30 m2 building area and 4 m ridge height, placed on the plot, with at most 45 m2 of such buildings in total (PBL 9 kap. 4 §)

A bygglov is always required if the property is in a culturally valuable area
Placement close to the property boundary may need the neighbours' consent
